C-TEST-PLACEMENT-CONVENTION.Summary: Make plugin test placement explicit and consistent: rename the nine plugin-entry integration suites to *.integration.test.ts at src/plugins root and move the twelve misplaced unit suites into their owning plugin directories, then document the convention in AGENTS.md.
C-TEST-PLACEMENT-CONVENTION.Problem: Plugin tests follow an implicit, asymmetric layout. Nine suites that exercise plugin entries through X/index.js live at src/plugins root with unit-sounding names, while twelve suites that test module internals (seven hashline-edit and five tool-history-compaction files) also sit at src/plugins root next to them, and other plugins keep unit tests inside their directories. workflow.delegated.test.ts at root (integration) is indistinguishable by name from workflow/delegated.test.ts (unit), which misleads navigation and review scoping.

Goals.Goal: Every plugin-entry integration suite is named NAME.integration.test.ts and lives at src/plugins root.
Every module-internals unit suite lives inside its owning plugin directory beside the implementation it tests, with corrected relative imports.
AGENTS.md documents the placement convention and its existing workflow-impact reference points to the renamed file.
Durable graph Paths and verification command paths reference the new locations truthfully; all tests pass under the new names with unchanged content.

Constraints.Constraint: Renames and moves only: no test logic, fixtures, assertions, or coverage change; file content changes are limited to the FILE header path and import specifiers broken by the move.

Integration renames: guardian, hashline-edit, model-roles, system-context-injection, tool-history-compaction, web-tools, workflow, workflow.delegated, and workflow.execution gain the .integration.test.ts suffix and stay at src/plugins root.

Unit moves: hashline-edit.edit-operations, hashline-edit.normalize-edits, hashline-edit.routing, hashline-edit.session-state, hashline-edit.str-replace-editor, hashline-edit.tool-description, hashline-edit.validation, tool-history-compaction.config, tool-history-compaction.prune, tool-history-compaction.read-slim, tool-history-compaction.saved-output, and tool-history-compaction.transform move into their plugin directories with ./hashline-edit/x.js specifiers rewritten to ./x.js and ../lib specifiers to ../../lib.
Bun test discovery keeps matching both *.test.ts and *.integration.test.ts with no configuration change.
This bundle executes after C-OPENCODE-MODULE-SPLIT, C-WORKFLOW-INDEX-REDUCE, and C-SPEC-LINT-RULES-SPLIT, because their recorded command evidence references the current test paths.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No new tests, no test splitting or merging, no assertion strengthening, and no moves for tests already correctly placed inside plugin directories or under src/lib, src/commands, src/tui, or scripts.
No src/plugins/integration directory, no bunfig or package.json script changes, no CI workflow changes.
No source (non-test) file changes beyond none expected; if a moved test imports a non-exported helper through a path that breaks, the import is re-pointed, not the source refactored.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: AC-01: The nine integration suites exist at src/plugins root with the .integration.test.ts suffix and no stale old-named files remain; their FILE headers and any internal path references match the new paths.
AC-02: The twelve unit suites exist inside their owning plugin directories with working imports; no stale root-level copies remain.

AC-03: AGENTS.md states the placement convention (unit tests beside implementation, plugin-entry integration suites as NAME.integration.test.ts at src/plugins root) and its workflow impact-table reference uses the renamed workflow integration test path.
AC-04: .grace/verification command paths and .grace/graph Paths (including M-PLUGIN-WORKFLOW) reference the new test locations; bun test src/plugins, bun run check, grace lint, and grace status pass.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Target assertions verify the nine new integration paths and twelve new unit paths exist and the old root-level names are absent from AGENTS.md. bun test src/plugins/ passing over the renamed layout with unchanged test content is the evidence that discovery and imports remain intact.

Assumptions.Assumption: hashline-edit.test.ts counts as integration because it exercises the plugin entry among its imports; its internals-focused siblings are the ones that move.
No non-test source file imports any moved test file; a pre-move grep confirms this during execution.
Approval provenance: the user explicitly instructed autonomous formalization of the five reviewed refactoring items, including this convention cleanup.
